criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: COVID-19 General Information
categories.definition: User seeks basic understanding, definitions, or clarification on common beliefs/myths about COVID-19.

categories.name: Symptoms & Diagnosis
categories.definition: User asks about specific symptoms, how to identify them, or how to know if they have/had the virus.

categories.name: Transmission & Persistence
categories.definition: User asks how the virus spreads, how long it survives on surfaces, or if animals can transmit/contract it.

categories.name: Prevention & Personal Protection
categories.definition: User seeks advice on measures to prevent infection for themselves or others, including cleaning, masks, and social distancing.

categories.name: Travel & Public Safety
categories.definition: User asks about safety of travel, current restrictions, or risks associated with specific locations or public activities.

categories.name: Treatment & Vaccine Information
categories.definition: User asks about available treatments, cures, or vaccine development and availability.

categories.name: Statistics & Latest Updates
categories.definition: User seeks current data, news, or official statements regarding the pandemic.

categories.name: Sharing & Social Engagement
categories.definition: User expresses intent to share information, the bot, or engage socially with the platform.

categories.name: Donation & Support
categories.definition: User expresses intent to donate money or resources, or asks how to support relief efforts.

categories.name: Greetings & Gratitude
categories.definition: User expresses a greeting, thanks, or general positive sentiment towards the bot.

categories.name: Emotional & Personal Concern
categories.definition: User expresses fear, anxiety, or a general sense of helplessness related to the pandemic.
